Component.Text: In JUCE, an animation is C++ code: you build a juce::Animator, keep it updated with a VBlankAnimatorUpdater, and apply every value it calls back with yourself. JIVE borrows CSS's transition syntax instead. List the properties that should animate, each with a duration, an easing curve and an optional delay, and any change to them animates on its own, whether it comes from C++, a :hover state or a file saved while the app runs.
